# ContHunt
> ContHunt is a content intelligence platform for discovering, comparing, and analyzing viral short-form videos across social platforms.

## Main pages
- [ContHunt homepage](https://conthunt.app/): Product overview, workflow, supported research signals, and pricing.
- [ContHunt blog](https://conthunt.app/blog): Research-backed guides for short-form video strategy, analytics, trends, and competitor analysis.
- [About ContHunt](https://conthunt.app/about): Editorial standards, product context, and team information.
- [Editorial team](https://conthunt.app/editorial): How ContHunt content is researched and reviewed.
- [Privacy policy](https://conthunt.app/privacy): Data and privacy terms.
- [Terms of service](https://conthunt.app/terms): Product terms.

## Key facts
- ContHunt searches public short-form video content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms.
- Analysis covers velocity, engagement, hooks, pacing, overlays, comments, format, and niche context.
- Source creators and original links remain available for human review.
- The product is designed for creators, agencies, and brand content teams.
